sources.name: Asura Scans
sources.changes:
- Asura Scans through its own JSON API: catalog (/api/series, 20/page, offset pagination, server-side
  search), title metadata (/api/series/<slug>), chapter lists (/api/series/<slug>/chapters), page
  URLs (/api/series/<slug>/chapters/<number> → CDN webp images).

sources.name: Kingdom Read
sources.changes:
- Kingdom (single-series site): the catalog is the series itself (h1, meta description, cover from
  the homepage), all chapters (~890, parsed from kingdom-chapter-<n> slugs) as units, reader pages
  from laiond.com images on each chapter page.

sources.name: Kingofshojo
sources.changes:
- Categories: the catalog filter lists the site's genres (110, read from the homepage's /genres/<slug>/
  links). A chosen genre switches the catalog to /genres/<slug>/page/<n>/; browsing everything is unchanged.

sources.name: MangaDex
sources.changes:
- Categories: the catalog filter offers MangaDex's tag list (/manga/tag, all 77 tags as the site names them),
  sent as includedTags[] together with search and language. Browse without a category is unchanged.

sources.name: ManhuaUS
sources.changes:
- ManhuaUS (WordPress Madara): paginated catalog with server-side search, metadata from the title
  page, the full chapter list read from the JSON embedded in script#mk-chapters-data, reader
  images with data-src/src attribute fallback.

sources.name: Rolia Scan
sources.changes:
- Rolia Scan through the site's own endpoints: catalog search via POST /wp-json/manga/v1/load
  (24/page), title page for metadata and the numeric manga id, chapter lists from the signed
  /auth/manga-chapters endpoint (md5 time token reproduced with {{unix}}, {{utc:...}} and the
  md5 transform), pages from /auth/chapter-content (images on roliascan.org).

sources.name: ToonSpace (toon.free)
sources.changes:
First draft.

- Catalog from the JSON explore API (/api/explore) with cursor pagination.
- Titles from /title/<slug>, chapter pages from /read/<slug>/chapter-<n>.
- No server-side search (the site searches client-side); video "shorts" items appear with an
  empty chapter list.
